args.response:
Refined Requirement 41 for the web-calculator spec. Key changes:

1. Split the compound criterion 6 (which mixed a nominal WHEN...SHALL coverage-measurement path with an IF...THEN failure path) into two separate criteria — now criteria 8 (measurement/application of Coverage_Threshold) and 9 (failure outcome) — to satisfy the EARS "split compound actions" rule and remove the pattern misuse.

2. Added a new criterion (6) closing a precision/test-blocker gap: the original criterion 5 referenced "switching between RPN_Mode and Standard_Mode" but never defined the observable state of the Stack_Display on switch. The new criterion specifies the Stack_Display and in-progress operand entry reset to empty with no residual Stack_Levels.

3. Added a new criterion (7) closing a frontend error-path gap: the original tests only mocked successful calls. The new criterion verifies behavior when the intercepting mock returns a Backend_Service error response during RPN_Mode (error indication rendered, no calculated result, Stack_Display retained).

4. Tightened criterion 10 (originally 7) to also require zero test collection errors, so "zero failures and zero errors" is unambiguous when a test cannot be collected/run.

Budget respected: 2 new criteria added (6, 7) plus 1 resulting from the mandatory compound split (6→8/9); all other original criteria preserved verbatim. Glossary terms, requirement number/title, user story, and all cross-referenced requirement numbers (2, 30, 36, 38) preserved. No implementation details, status codes beyond the already-present "4xx range", color/path/schema details were introduced.
